thread:
SRE Bot: PAGING: high GPU queue depth on customer private cluster acme-edge-01 — sustained queue > 450 requests, autoscaler failing to bring up nodes (scale errors). Severity: P1.
Jayden (oncall): seeing the alert, joining. what's the immediate customer impact?
Amy (CS): Acme reports increased inference latencies and 502s for some requests. Their dashboard shows tail latency spikes about 2x baseline. They say impact started ~10m ago.
Jayden (oncall): thanks. Priya / Noah, can you pull the scaler logs? suspecting node boot failures or imagepull throttling.
Priya (eng-runtime): on it. grabbing autoscaler logs. initial grep: `Error creating node: VolumeAttach timeout` repeated, and `maxPods quota exceeded` on some AZs. Also kubelet register errors for newly provisioned instances.
Noah (infra): looking at cloud console — several boot attempts in acme-edge-01 AZ b failed with `insufficient IPs` on the subnet and one with `image pull rate limit`. Subnet CIDR nearly exhausted.
Jayden (oncall): ok that lines up: autoscaler keeps requesting nodes, they fail to join, queue keeps growing. Immediate mitigations?
Priya (eng-runtime): can we temporarily enable fallback routing to hosted inference for this customer while we clear provisioning? Adding routing rule to send non-sensitive workloads off-cluster. Patch below:
```
# patch: prefer: hosted->dedicated->private
route: 
  - if customer == "acme" and queue_depth > 200 then route: hosted-fallback
```
Applying now (will take ~30s to propagate).
Amy (CS): Acme: we can shift non-PHI traffic if you approve — they replied yes to fallback.
SRE Bot: NOTE: automated canary rollover disabled for acme due to compliance flag; manual override applied by Jayden.
Jayden (oncall): applied routing override. Starting to see decrease in queue for non-sensitive requests. Still ~300 sensitive requests stuck.
Maria (customer): can you ETA when private cluster will be back to normal? Sensitive requests are the blocking ones.
Noah (infra): options: 1) Expand subnet IPs — requires infra approval and we might need to provision a new ENI range, 2) Reclaim inactive IPs (fast but risky), 3) Ask acme to offload some workloads. I'd prefer #1 but it's a ~15min change plus node reprovision.
Priya (eng-runtime): while infra expands subnet, we can try a temporary hotfix: patch node bootstrap to skip some init hooks (non-critical) so nodes join faster. Risk: reduced monitoring bootstrap. If accepted, can push in ~5m.
Jayden (oncall): do it. Prioritize join speed. Priya, please post exact kube commands and we keep watch on join events.
Priya (eng-runtime): executing hotpatch. commands: `kubectl -n kube-system set env daemonset/cloud-init SKIP_LONG_INIT=true` and restart bootstrap pods. Also increasing scaler's maxSurge from 3 to 8 to allow more parallel boots: `kubectl patch deployment autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"autoscaler","env":[{"name":"MAX_SURGE","value":"8"}] }]}}}'`
SRE Bot: Deploy started: autoscaler config patch + bootstrap env change.
Jayden (oncall): monitoring nodes.
Priya (eng-runtime): nodes beginning to join. Seeing `Registered node acme-edge-01-node-64` repeated. Queue draining for sensitive requests slowly, now 120 stuck.
Noah (infra): subnet expansion in progress — allocated additional /28 to the VPC pool. Will attach in ~10m.
Amy (CS): told Acme we're performing a hotpatch and subnet expansion. They acknowledged and are on standby.
Jayden (oncall): quick health check: error rate down from 7%->1.2%. Latency tail still elevated but improving. Logging: `autoscaler: node join success` events increased.
Maria (customer): thanks — we see retries succeeding now for some sensitive models. We'll keep traffic at reduced rate.
Priya (eng-runtime): autoscaler logs show fewer `maxPods quota` hits after join. Remaining failures were due to one old AMI in the image set — pulling older image triggered rate limit. We're replacing fleet with new image digest. Rolling update queued.
Noah (infra): subnet attach completed. New nodes can request IPs normally.
Jayden (oncall): great. Priya, complete AMI replacement and rolling update; Noah, keep an eye on cloud quotas. Amy, coordinate a post-incident note to Acme.
Priya (eng-runtime): rolling update of node pool kicked off. Expected finish ~20m.
SRE Bot: Incident timeline updated: alert triggered 1769504321, routing override applied 1769504445, hotpatch applied 1769504700, subnet attach 1769505200.
Jayden (oncall): handing off to Noah for next 2 hours to monitor rolling update and customer impact. If anything flares, page SRE oncall.
Noah (infra): taking over. Will post progress updates.
Ops Bot: Reminder — please file postmortem ticket and tag `pm-owners=eng-runtime,infra,sre` and `severity=P1` within 24h.
Jayden (oncall): thanks team. closing pager for now; keep thread updated with any regressions. :thumbsup:
